title: Source-grounded verification of the Dumont et al. planetary-forcing-of-seismicity and Le Mouël solar-dynamo claims in OTA-SCI-0042
question: Audit the [R]/ESTABLISHED planetary-forcing claims in OTA-SCI-0042-2026-DE against the primary sources. (a) Does 'On a planetary forcing of global seismicity' (Dumont, de Bremond d'Ars, Boulé, Courtillot, Gèze, Gibert, Kossobokov, Le Mouël, Lopes et al., Frontiers in Earth Science 13, 1587650, 2025, DOI 10.3389/feart.2025.1587650) exist as cited with that author list, and does it actually report seven LOD periodicities (1, 3.4, 11, 14, 18.6, 33, 60 yr) in global seismicity and an SSA decomposition reproducing ~90% of seismic variance with 7 components? (b) Does 'On the planetary forcing of the Solar dynamo' (Le Mouël, Courtillot et al., arXiv:2511.18939v2) report 11 common SSN/LOD periods with bootstrap p ≤ 10⁻³, and is the document's rendering '99.9% correlation — strongest external support' a defensible reading of that significance? (c) Are the individual periods (especially the 1-yr and 3.4-yr terms, which could reflect seasonal/atmospheric rather than planetary forcing) present in the primary tables, and which of the paper's statements are framed by the authors as established vs hypothetical? (d) What is the current state of the broader 'planetary/lunar/tidal forcing of seismicity' literature — is the Dumont et al. conclusion representative, contested, or a minority position, and does any subsequent 2025-2026 work support or contradict the claimed periodicities?
why_now: The LOD-to-seismicity link is the middle 'ESTABLISHED' segment of the AVI causal chain in OTA-SCI-0042, and the document's summary tables assert very specific quantitative results (90% seismic variance with 7 SSA components, p ≤ 10⁻³, '99.9% correlation') that must be confirmed against the primary papers before they are reused in OTA-SCI-0036, OTA-OBS-0005 and OTA-SCI-0041. Planetary forcing of seismicity is a live and contested research area, so a current-literature positioning check is materially useful; no prior OTA research topic has audited these two papers.
real_world_anchor: Dumont, S. et al. (2025), 'On a planetary forcing of global seismicity', Frontiers in Earth Science 13, 1587650, DOI 10.3389/feart.2025.1587650; Le Mouël, J.L., Courtillot, V. et al. (2025), 'On the planetary forcing of the Solar dynamo', arXiv:2511.18939v2

(2025) solar-dynamo preprint, or the LOD-periodicity-in-seismicity claims; earlier topics cover unrelated [R] anchors and do not touch the seismicity or Earth-rotation literature.
